basics.name: Hector Olea
basics.label: Full-Stack Developer
basics.summary: Full-Stack Developer with 12+ years of experience designing, modernizing, and scaling enterprise applications. Specialized in Java, Spring Boot, and microservices, with a strong focus on clean architecture, automated testing, and event-driven systems using Kafka. I pair solid engineering practices with AI-assisted development — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and MCP integrations — to ship reliable, maintainable software faster.

highlights: Remediating security vulnerabilities across Java and React applications, hardening a large-scale financial platform on AWS.
Refactoring legacy services and adding Cypress regression suites to protect critical user flows.
Automating infrastructure and delivery workflows with Terraform, GitLab CI, and Python.
Refactored 30% of an insurance platform's Angular and Java microservices codebase to align with Spring Boot best practices.
Raised test coverage from 0% to 20% with JUnit and Mockito, improving system reliability.
Kept a financial analytics platform stable and performant by resolving production incidents and optimizing workflows.
Reduced incident response times through structured incident management with ServiceNow.
Built and enhanced Java microservices for a banking platform, integrating customer data via SSN and expanding case and product management capabilities.
Introduced the first automated tests on legacy services, improving maintainability.
Built and maintained 15+ Spring Boot and Node.js microservices in a high-scale retail environment.
Migrated services to Walmart’s Cloud Native platform and Kafka, improving scalability and reducing deployment complexity.
Modernized Spring Boot applications, Docker images, and project dependencies, strengthening security and stability.
Automated support tasks with Bash and Python, improving operational efficiency.
Automated operational workflows for the airline, cutting manual effort and improving efficiency.
Built monitoring and incident-handling automations with Python, Bash, and REST APIs integrated with ServiceNow.
Maintained an invoicing system processing transactions from FTP text files, ensuring reliable data integration.
Improved Oracle database performance through SQL/PLSQL tuning and automated bulk data loading.
Maintained and supported the SIMBAD census database system, ensuring data accuracy and stable performance.
